failures.description: client created without its runtime/config plane
failures.test_name: real route + PG: a desktop seed failure creates no client and the retry converges once
failures.required_assertion: seed failure commits neither client nor runtime plane and retry converges once

failures.description: boot heal fails but runtime still appears healthy
failures.test_name: real PostgreSQL composes every admitted creation path, reset/heal, and the registered mutations
failures.required_assertion: a failed boot heal leaves an explicit non-ready state and root-cause receipt

failures.description: creation paths produce different identity/chart/authority state

failures.required_assertion: every admitted creation path re-reads the same canonical birth contract

failures.description: noncanonical legal form defeats country-pack resolution

failures.description: same-derived-id cross-firm collision or reassignment

failures.required_assertion: a colliding id cannot move the original client, owner, or sidecars across firms

failures.description: reset loses config or authority silently, or re-arms authority incorrectly
failures.test_name: real PostgreSQL composes every admitted creation path, reset/heal, and the registered mutations
failures.required_assertion: reset receipts every purged grant and restores only baseline authority

failures.description: stale/cross-client facts, memory, artifacts, asks or work

failures.description: first-upload registration failure detached from creation

failures.description: local evidence misclassified as missing

failures.description: material hold with no owner ask
failures.required_assertion: every material hold rests on a specific named customer-human question

failures.description: model allowed to skip source-of-truth admitted work
failures.required_assertion: model output covers each admitted non-terminal item exactly once

failures.description: opaque database-id confusion across similar candidates

failures.description: date serialization changes the accounting day
failures.required_assertion: PostgreSQL dates preserve their accounting calendar day across every prompt and surface

failures.description: successful transition receipt hides a non-terminal consequence
failures.required_assertion: every independently applicable transition reaches one lawful terminal consequence

failures.description: group mutation shows lifecycle for only the focused row
failures.required_assertion: start and settle lifecycle events cover every row changed by a group action

failures.description: confident terminal row cannot be corrected because no review sidecar exists
failures.required_assertion: correction mints a missing case through the named writer and posts the corrected journal

failures.description: retry/dead-letter loses the root cause or never self-heals
failures.required_assertion: dead-letter retains the cause and eligible work can re-enter without a new upload

failures.description: crash/replay duplicates journals, asks, facts or work

failures.description: account label and posting code diverge

failures.description: deployed model/config differs from the evaluated one
failures.required_assertion: the response model and exact runtime configuration match the qualified artifact

failures.description: spend is unknown or provider retries are untracked

failures.description: rerun-until-green flake laundering

failures.description: unclear external-document provenance, consent or provider-egress rights
failures.required_assertion: unknown rights quarantine the asset and withdrawal propagates deletion with a receipt
